Skin looking dull, tanned or uneven no matter what you put on it? A glutathione IV drip delivers your body's master antioxidant straight into your bloodstream, helping your skin look brighter, clearer and more even from within. Treatment overview

What is a Glutathione IV Drip?

Glutathione is a powerful antioxidant your body makes naturally. It protects your cells, helps the liver clear toxins and supports your immune system. It also plays a part in how much pigment your skin produces.

Sun, pollution, stress, poor sleep and age all drain your glutathione levels, and it often shows on your skin as tan, dullness and an uneven tone. A glutathione IV drip tops your levels back up by delivering glutathione straight into a vein, where your body can use it fully. Over a course of weekly sessions, skin looks brighter, clearer and more radiant, and many people feel more energised too.

Read more: how glutathione works in the skin

Skin makes two kinds of melanin: darker eumelanin and lighter pheomelanin. Glutathione slows tyrosinase, the enzyme that starts melanin production, and nudges it towards the lighter type. It also mops up free radicals from sun and pollution that make skin look tired and uneven.

The effect is gradual and works with your natural skin tone. It doesn't bleach the skin. It helps it look its healthiest and most even.

1. DeliverGlutathione goes straight into the bloodstream for full absorption.
2. ProtectIt neutralises free radicals and supports your body's natural detox.
3. BrightenOver weekly sessions, tan and dullness fade for a more even glow.

Glutathione explained

Everything You Need to Know

Tap a question to read the answer. Short, clear and honest.

What is glutathione?
Glutathione is a small molecule made naturally in every cell of your body from three amino acids: glutamine, cysteine and glycine. It's often called the "master antioxidant" because it protects cells from damage, helps the liver process toxins and keeps the immune system working well.
Why do glutathione levels drop?
Your body makes less glutathione with age. Levels also fall with stress, poor sleep, pollution, sun exposure, smoking, alcohol, illness and intense exercise. Low levels can show up as tired, dull skin and low energy.
How does glutathione brighten skin?
Melanin is the pigment that gives skin its colour. Glutathione slows down tyrosinase, the enzyme that makes melanin, and shifts production towards a lighter form of pigment. It also fights the oxidative stress that makes skin look dull. Together, this helps skin look brighter and more even over a course of sessions.
Why an IV drip instead of tablets?
Glutathione taken by mouth is largely broken down in the stomach and gut before it reaches the blood. An IV drip delivers it straight into the bloodstream, so much more of it is available to your cells.
Why is vitamin C often added?
Vitamin C is an antioxidant too, and it helps keep glutathione in its active form. It also supports collagen for healthier-looking skin. Your doctor will tell you exactly what's in your drip.
Brightening vs whitening: what to expect
A glutathione drip won't change your natural skin colour. What it can do is help reduce tan and dullness so your own skin tone looks brighter, clearer and more even. Results vary from person to person and are best with daily sunscreen.
How long do the results last?
The glow builds gradually over a course and usually lasts a few months. Sun exposure, stress and lifestyle affect how long. Monthly maintenance drips and daily SPF help keep results.
Is it only for women?
No. Men use glutathione drips for tan, dull skin, energy and recovery after training.

Inside the drip

What Your Drip Can Contain

Every drip is planned by our doctors. These are the most common ingredients.

Glutathione
The master antioxidant. It's the main ingredient for skin glow and even tone, and it supports detox and immunity.
Vitamin C
An antioxidant that helps keep glutathione active and supports collagen for healthier-looking skin.
B vitamins
Help your body turn food into energy. Often included in wellness and recovery drips.
Hydrating fluids
A saline base that rehydrates you and carries the ingredients into your bloodstream.

The exact contents depend on the drip you choose and your health check.

Skin Concerns Glutathione Can Help

Tap a concern to see how glutathione helps and what to expect.

Kerala's strong sun leaves many people with a stubborn tan on the face, neck and arms. Glutathione helps slow new pigment and supports the skin as the tan fades, for a more even look.

  • Helps tan fade faster
  • More even face and body
  • Best with daily SPF

Stress, late nights and pollution drain the skin's antioxidants, leaving it flat and grey-looking. Topping up glutathione helps bring back a healthy glow.

  • Fresher, brighter skin
  • Healthy radiance
  • Often noticed after 2 to 3 drips

Patchy, uneven skin tone often comes from sun damage and old marks. Glutathione helps the overall tone look more even.

  • More even complexion
  • Softer-looking dark patches
  • Works with your skincare

Glutathione supports brighter, clearer skin and can help marks look softer. Deeper pigmentation like melasma needs targeted treatment too, so we plan both together.

Realistic results

Kerala's climate
Heat, humidity and strong UV all increase oxidative stress. That's why many people here notice a clear difference with antioxidant support.

A gentle cleanser, moisturiser, sunscreen and a doctor-recommended brightening serum help the results show and last.

Your course

How a Glutathione Course Works

Glutathione works best as a short course of weekly drips, followed by maintenance.

  1. Week 1

    Health check and first drip

    A quick consultation and health screening, then your first 30 to 45 minute drip.

  2. Weeks 2–3

    Feel the difference

    Many people feel refreshed and notice fresher-looking skin after 2 to 3 drips.

  3. Weeks 4–8

    See the glow

    Skin looks brighter, clearer and more even as the course builds.

  4. Monthly

    Maintain

    One drip a month, plus daily sunscreen, helps keep your glow.

Your appointment

Glutathione IV Drip Procedure

A health check comes first.

  • Your doctor talks through your goals, medical history, allergies and medicines.
  • We check your blood pressure and make sure the drip is safe for you.
  • Drink plenty of water the day before and on the day, so veins are easier to find.
  • Eat a light meal before you come. Don't come on an empty stomach.
  • Avoid alcohol for 24 hours before.

The drip runs for 30 to 45 minutes.

  • You relax in a comfortable chair.
  • A thin cannula is placed in a vein in your arm, with a small pinch.
  • The drip runs slowly, and our team checks on you throughout.
  • You can read, use your phone or simply rest.
  • Tell us straight away if you feel unwell or uncomfortable.

Go straight back to your day.

  • The cannula is removed and a small plaster applied.
  • Press on the spot for a minute to prevent bruising.
  • Keep drinking water through the day.
  • Apply sunscreen every day to protect your results.
  • Book your next drip in about a week.

Results

What Results Can You Expect?

Glutathione works gradually, so your skin looks naturally brighter, not suddenly different.

A good fit if you

  • Have tan, dullness or uneven tone
  • Want a brighter glow before a wedding or event
  • Feel tired and run down
  • Want antioxidant support for your skin and body

Not ideal if you

  • Are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • Want to change your natural skin colour
  • Have deep melasma and want a single fix
  • Skip sunscreen

Illustrative model images. Results vary from person to person.

Aftercare

Make Your Glow Last

Simple habits that help glutathione work and keep your results going.

Do

  • Keep the plaster on for an hour
  • Drink plenty of water
  • Eat a balanced meal

Avoid

  • Heavy lifting with the drip arm
  • Alcohol
  • Rubbing the drip site

Do

  • SPF 30 or higher, reapplied outdoors
  • Fruits and vegetables rich in vitamin C
  • 7 to 8 hours of sleep
  • Gentle, hydrating skincare

Avoid

  • Midday sun without protection
  • Smoking
  • Too much alcohol and junk food

Myths vs facts

Glutathione Myths, Busted

"Glutathione will make me several shades fairer."
It helps your natural tone look brighter and more even. It doesn't change the skin colour you were born with.
"One drip is enough."
Results build over a course of weekly drips, usually 4 to 8.
"Tablets work just as well."
Much of the glutathione in tablets is broken down in the gut. An IV drip delivers it straight into the blood.
"Results last forever."
Sun, stress and lifestyle wear them down. Monthly maintenance and daily SPF help.
"It's just a beauty fad."
Glutathione is a real antioxidant your body depends on. Its effects on skin are gradual and work best alongside good skincare.

Questions

Glutathione IV Drip FAQs

What is a glutathione IV drip?
A glutathione IV drip delivers glutathione, your body's main antioxidant, straight into a vein through a thin cannula. It's used to help skin look brighter and more even, and to support antioxidant protection, immunity and energy.
Does glutathione IV make skin fairer?
It won't change your natural skin colour. It can help reduce tan and dullness so your own skin tone looks brighter and more even. Results vary from person to person.
How many glutathione drips will I need?
Most people have 4 to 8 sessions, once a week, followed by a monthly maintenance drip. Your doctor will plan the number based on your goals.
When will I see results?
Some people notice fresher skin after 2 to 3 sessions. Brighter, more even skin usually shows after 4 to 6 weekly drips.
How long does a session take?
About 30 to 45 minutes. You sit back in a comfortable chair while the drip runs.
Does it hurt?
You'll feel a small pinch when the cannula goes in, like a blood test. After that, most people feel nothing and simply relax.
Is glutathione IV safe?
When given by trained medical staff after a proper health check, it's generally well tolerated. We screen every patient first, use quality, sterile products and monitor you during the drip.
What are the side effects?
Mild bruising or soreness at the drip site is the most common. Some people feel a cool sensation in the arm, a mild headache or light-headedness. Allergic reactions are rare, which is why we monitor you.
Who should not have a glutathione drip?
It isn't advised during pregnancy or breastfeeding, or for people with known allergies to the ingredients. People with kidney or liver disease, asthma, or G6PD deficiency (if vitamin C is included) need a doctor's assessment first.
Is IV better than glutathione tablets?
IV delivery puts glutathione straight into the bloodstream. Tablets are largely broken down in the gut, so less reaches your cells. Some people use both, with their doctor's advice.
Do I need to avoid the sun?
Yes, as much as you can. Sun exposure triggers new tan and pigment, so daily SPF 30 or higher is essential to see and keep results.
Can men take glutathione drips?
Yes. Men use them for tan, dull skin, energy and recovery.
What's the difference between Beauty Elixir, Wellness and Recovery drips?
Beauty Elixir focuses on skin glow and even tone. Wellness Drips support energy and immunity. Recovery Drips help you bounce back after illness, travel or training.
Can I go back to work after the drip?
Yes. There's no downtime, so you can go straight back to your day.
Where can I get a glutathione IV drip in Kerala?
Facelit offers glutathione IV drips in Trivandrum and Karunagappally (Kollam).
How much does a glutathione IV drip cost?
It depends on the drip and the number of sessions. Our packages include buy 3 get 1 free and buy 5 get 2 free offers. Book a consultation for a personalised quote.
